title: M2 L2 Part 3 — Will you lend it to me? (Side Story)
readingPassages: Side Story — Kate and Riku (break time):
Kate: I watched the Peter Rabbit movie. It was great.
Riku: Did you watch it at home?
Kate: Yes. I have the DVD.
Kate: Of course. I'm sure you'll love the movie.
I think Stand by Me is a good adventure movie. I'm sure you'll like it.
